"""Build the batching comparison report for seeds 0-9."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from run import arrivals, latencies, summarize

SEEDS = range(10)
WORKLOADS = ("sparse", "burst")


def build():
    runs = []
    for seed in SEEDS:
        for w in WORKLOADS:
            t = arrivals(seed, w)
            s1, s16 = summarize(latencies(t, 1)), summarize(latencies(t, 16))
            runs.append({"seed": seed, "workload": w, "arrivals": len(t),
                         "size_1": s1, "size_16": s16,
                         "mean_delta_ms": s16["mean_ms"] - s1["mean_ms"],
                         "p95_delta_ms": s16["p95_ms"] - s1["p95_ms"]})
    return runs


def conclusion(runs):
    parts = []
    for w in WORKLOADS:
        r = [x for x in runs if x["workload"] == w]
        m1 = sum(x["size_1"]["mean_ms"] for x in r) / len(r)
        m16 = sum(x["size_16"]["mean_ms"] for x in r) / len(r)
        faster = sum(x["mean_delta_ms"] < 0 for x in r)
        parts.append(f"{w}: n={r[0]['arrivals']} requests/seed over {len(r)} seeds; "
                     f"mean latency size 1 = {m1:.2f} ms, size 16 = {m16:.2f} ms; "
                     f"size 16 lower in {faster}/{len(r)} seeds")
    return ("; ".join(parts) + ". Batching 16 is not uniformly better; see per-workload results. "
            "Note the sparse trace has 31 requests (index 17 missing telemetry), not 32.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    runs = build()
    out = Path(sys.argv[1])
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps({"runs": runs, "conclusion": conclusion(runs)}, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(conclusion(runs))
EOF
